SELECT product_name, brand, price_eur, skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
ORDER BY price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT product_name, brand, price_eur, skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'laptop'
  AND last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
ORDER BY price_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS prices_collected
FROM price_snapshots
WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT product_name, brand, category, drop_date, prev_price, new_price, drop_eur
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE drop_date >= (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots) - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY drop_eur ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    drop_date,
    prev_price,
    new_price,
    drop_eur,
    drop_pct,
    skroutz_link
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE category = 'laptop'
  AND drop_date >= (
        SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots
    ) - INTERVAL '6 days'
ORDER BY drop_pct ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dropped_count
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE drop_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_products_count
FROM products
WHERE first_seen >= (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots) - INTERVAL '7 days'
LIMIT 50

SELECT AVG(price_eur) AS average_price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 1

SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS phone_count
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'phone'
GROUP BY brand
ORDER BY phone_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cheapest_s24 AS (
    SELECT l.id, l.product_name, l.price_eur AS current_price
    FROM mv_latest_prices l
    WHERE l.category = 'phone'
      AND l.brand ILIKE 'samsung'
      AND l.product_name ILIKE '%galaxy s24%'
      AND l.last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
    ORDER BY l.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.product_name, f.all_time_low AS lowest_price_ever
FROM cheapest_s24 c
JOIN mv_price_floor f ON f.product_id = c.id
LIMIT 50

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
),
cheapest AS (
    SELECT l.id, l.product_name
    FROM mv_latest_prices l
    CROSS JOIN latest
    WHERE l.category = 'phone'
      AND l.brand ILIKE 'samsung'
      AND l.product_name ILIKE '%galaxy s24%'
      AND l.last_price_date = latest.max_date
    ORDER BY l.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT h.date, h.price_eur, c.product_name
FROM mv_price_history h
JOIN cheapest c ON c.id = h.product_id
JOIN latest l ON h.date BETWEEN l.max_date - INTERVAL '6 days' AND l.max_date
ORDER BY h.date
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_smartwatches_under_50
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'smartwatch'
  AND last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
  AND price_eur < 50
LIMIT 1

SELECT l.product_name, l.brand, l.rating, l.reviews, l.price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices l
WHERE l.category = 'laptop'
  AND l.reviews > 50
  AND l.last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
ORDER BY l.rating DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS falling_trend_count
FROM mv_price_trend_direction
WHERE trend = 'falling'
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_phones
FROM products p
JOIN mv_latest_prices l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'phone'
  AND p.ram_gb = 16
  AND l.last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 1

SELECT 'NO_DATA' AS no_data WHERE false
LIMIT 50
